This paper identifies critical success factors for digitalization in materials and chemicals and how the Citrine Platform supports them. White Paper – How an AI-Enabled Data Infrastructure Impacts the Bottom Line Learn how materials informatics can systematically improve return on investment (ROI) for new product development, with a platform that becomes more powerful with each new project. White Paper – Increasing Polymer Sustainability Using AI This white paper examines how the Citrine Platform leverages advanced artificial intelligence to help polymer manufacturers meet sustainability challenges while maintaining performance and profitability. White Paper – The Future of Consumer Packaging: Driving Sustainability with Machine Learning Technologies This white paper explores how artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are revolutionizing the consumer packaging industry, enabling companies to meet sustainability goals while maintaining performance and cost efficiency.
